title: Revalidate provider-authorized LLM subscription transports
exact_question: For each enabled Codex, Claude Code, Grok Build, and any Google adapter, verify current official authentication, noninteractive surface, subscription automation permission, data handling, and whether the intended tenant workload is authorized; disable any adapter lacking proof.
safe_boundary: No browser-cookie extraction, undocumented endpoint, subscription pooling/resale, or raw customer PII egress; self-hosted remains the default fallback.
unblock_condition: Provider-specific signed/current documentation and entitlement evidence are recorded, with unsupported adapters explicitly disabled.
release_impact: Blocks provider-transport live-fire proof only; does not block deterministic/local model paths.
